title: Lunatico connection poll can overwrite a queued focuser request
description:
Accepted Lunatico POSITION/STEPS intent is preserved until its queued worker starts. Old initial/external polls retain measured private position without overwriting requested public target/state; compensation and abort/disconnect ownership are coordinated. Both generated exports are versioned and covered by deterministic held-poll regression tests.
